comment: The worst Professor ever in my whole college journey so far, NEVER TAKE THAT PROFESSOR

This guy is bad. His lectures don't make any sense and it is like listening to an unresponsive robot. Doesn't even try to learn your name. Frequently gets his own problems wrong. Someone could've dropped dead in that class and he would've just plowed on with his lecture, which were very poor.

Isnard is fine. Every class is just him lecturing off of a PowerPoint which he posts online. Homework is easy. Midterms and finals are main source of final grade. Every exam was EXTREMELY curved. Didnt feel like I learned anything from the class but at least I got a good grade.

Professor Isnard was probably the worst teacher Ive ever had in my academic career. He didnt take the time or effort to learn names and rarely stopped to take questions during his sped-thru lectures. The honeworks were easy but didnt relate to the exams at all. The exams had barely anything to do with the lectures. Dont take Isnard.

Not to pile on, but this guy should not be teaching anywhere. The lectures were difficult to follow, making the homework really hard to do, then came the tests that no one was prepared for. But it didn't matter if you were prepared because the tests were completely different from everything we learned in class. Avoid this guy at ALL costs.

Isnard is the reason I am transferring from Richmond. His lectures are barely comprehendible, I have to learn all material on youtube. The homework, reviews, and in class lecturing DO NOT REFLECT WHAT IS ON THE EXAM. He refuses to learn students names, even though he has a class of 15 students, and is the worst educator I have ever encountered

this guy is the worst econ prof at the school, avoid taking his class. He lectures the whole time, we only have 2 mid terms and then a final and some homework grades. his midterms are impossible, he curves it heavily because everyone fails. He reviews for the midterm the class before, and the review is nothing like the test. DO NOT TAKE HIM.

Professor Isnard is a nice guy but his class is extremely boring. He goes through content extremely fast. He rarely takes much time to go through examples in class and often gets the answers wrong. I learned most of the content through the online homework site. Tests are very difficult and weighted heavily.

Dr. Isnard was not only inaccessible through email, but he also seemed completely uninterested in the teaching process. His lectures were not too fast-paced to follow, but the information taught in lectures did not align with exams.

If youre willing to put in some effort to study and use the materials he gives you to understand you'll do just fine. Although his lectures do go fast you can get everything you need and prepare ahead if you want by looking at the pwpt beforehand. Tests are different than expected but if you know the material it's manageable to apply concepts to qs

Professor Isnard is one of the worst instructors I've come across . While the material itself wasn't too difficult to grasp, he seems to rush through the material at lightning pace. He never responded to a single email. Exams are absolutely unpredictable, and no one is ever prepared. He also assigns way too much irrelevant work outside of class.

teaches way too fast and barely puts in the work to help his students. Tests are impossible and nearly everyone fails them. Your only chance of doing well is if you've already taken micro in high school. Don't take this class.

Hard course with impossible tests. Every class is a lecture and very fast paced. Available for help outside of class but most questions I was stil confused with even after asking about them. Curves heavily.

Takes attendance, but all of the information given in class is on his PowerPoint - the class is pretty boring. Mainly graded by exams, and the exam questions almost never connect to what we learned in class. not the most helpful class but expectations are clear

Professor Isnard is terrible and doesn't seem invested in teaching his students. He takes days, sometimes weeks to answer emails and is often condescending towards his students. He lectures are vague and go by in a flash. Tests are unreasonable impossible, making it impossible to prepare for. Just pray for a good curve on your grade. DON'T TAKE!

Avoid Isnard for Econ with your life. Doesnt really respond to emails, several people I know emailed him regarding final exam results and didnt get a response. Consistently fails kids on exams he does curve them, but not anywhere near enough and it really freaks you out when you see your raw score. Do yourself a favor, dont take Isnard

His lectures move really quickly and he explains the concepts only in a simple way. By the time you get to the homework or exams, the problems are a level of complexity that makes the class-taught concepts seem foreign. Definitely have to learn on your own to master the concepts and be ready for the exams.

Professor Isnard is not a good teacher. His lectures dont make sense, he mis-speaks and gets his own problems wrong, and has no idea how to teach economics. While he is a smart guy, he is an awful teacher. The class isnt hard to get an A, but you have to teach yourself, and seriously understand economics in order to do so.

Avoid Isnard for ECON 101 at all costs. This guy is the worst professor of all time. He fails every single kid on each exam for no reason and gives sub par curves. His classes are like having a robot read each chapter of the textbook at 2x speed. His lectures are incredibly fast and he doesn't prepare you for his ridiculously hard and unfair exams.
